---
title: "Attention in sequence models"
---

A short project on how attention replaced recurrence in sequence models. It includes:

- [A literature review](lit-review/index.qmd) of the work it builds on, citing the project's bibliography.
- [Presentation slides](slides/attention/index.qmd) for a short talk on the same question.
- [The paper](paper/html/index.qmd), written in LaTeX with co-authors in Overleaf.

An example workspace for the Asta workspace skill, built and published from main; see its [README](https://github.com/allenai/asta-plugins/tree/main/examples/workspace#readme) for the demo and how to start your own.
